principle: Do not imply a backend capability that the current public wire contract does not provide.

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/locations with cursor, filters, bbox/radius, and bounded limit
capabilities.frontend: Map viewport results, database result table, loading/partial-page context
Stable facility route with drawer/split/fullscreen presentation
Progressive filter controls, counts with release scope
Persistent release/profile/scope notice and share-state pinning

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/locations.csv, bounded rows and profile notice
capabilities.frontend: Explicit selected-release export with visible scope and limitation
Distinct map symbols/labels; no routing for city/unmapped

capabilities.backend: Projection fields for lifecycle, origin, source, URL, retrieval, release
capabilities.frontend: Evidence panel and filterable status; never rewrite source wording

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/graph/connections, /api/v2/graph/entities, and one-hop neighborhood; release/profile/suppression/privacy gated read-only projection over private source-qualified evidence
capabilities.frontend: Connections section on record detail and searchable/filterable graph rows. Never ship the operator-only private route.

capabilities.backend: Public edge DTO carries connection_type, confidence, confidence_band, method, grouped signals, contradictions, safe source references, ruleset, observed/computed dates, and persistent disclaimer
capabilities.frontend: Exact/high/medium/low presentation with explicit estimate disclaimer

capabilities.backend: Private neighborhood traversal exists; no public bounded traversal contract is frozen
capabilities.frontend: MVP supports one-hop public connections returned by the record endpoint; multi-hop is later

capabilities.backend: q over canonical name, city, country, category, source name per filters contract
capabilities.frontend: Debounced query with cancellable requests; no client-wide filtering

capabilities.backend: Categories are exposed; animal/activity detail depends on projection fields and source contract
capabilities.frontend: Keep V1 OR search intent and category labels where mapped; show unsupported fields as unavailable, not guessed

capabilities.backend: No current V2 public APHIS report endpoint in v2-contract.json
capabilities.frontend: Do not call legacy route from V2; preserve as a later evidence adapter

capabilities.backend: History exists privately but no public history endpoint is frozen
capabilities.frontend: Show first/last observed and count now; history timeline later

capabilities.backend: Current location DTO lacks evidence hashes and geocoder metadata
capabilities.frontend: Show available source URL/date; do not invent hashes

capabilities.backend: Profiles include official, secondary, community; each response carries profile and warning semantics
capabilities.frontend: Never mix profiles; community/unreviewed context must precede access and persist on rows, map, detail, and export
Optional future enhancement only with explicit consent; never persist or place in shared URLs/analytics

capabilities.backend: Graph edges are evidence relationships, not universal identity
capabilities.frontend: Never render inferred edge as merged node, ownership fact, or supply-chain proof

capabilities.backend: Separate /api/dev/preview and private graph routes require local authorization
capabilities.frontend: Development-only flag and unmistakable private/not-published banner; never bundled in production
